title: Programmable tissue-adhesive hydrogels with temporal and spatial selectivity
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01297F, Review Article
Lei Liang, Hong Zhang, Fanglian Yao, Junjie Li
This review examines hydrogel adhesion to wet tissues, summarizing current strategies and presenting methods to control adhesive strength across temporal and spatial dimensions.
